metadata.title: [ONNX] Invalid ONNX graph when exporting prim__Constant of empty tensor data

bug_description:
## 🐛 Bug



torch.onnx exports invalid ONNX for scalar `torch.zeros` followed by an inplace op.

trigger_conditions.pattern: Scalar Tensor Handling Failure During ONNX Graph Export
trigger_conditions.condition: Exporting models containing 0-dimensional scalar tensors created by torch.zeros(()) followed by in-place tensor operations, which causes ONNX graph conversion failure.
trigger_conditions.operation_context: Exporting a model that creates a 0-dim tensor with torch.zeros(()) and then applies an in-place operation such as y += x.

failure_behavior.description: Exporting a model that creates a 0-dim tensor with torch.zeros(()) and then applies an in-place operation such as y += x.
